Lovely cakes and great service by the lake
Mar 2026 • Solo
I stopped by this bakery and had a really nice experience. I tried the coffee macaron, mango macaron, Russian Medovik honey cake, and a chocolate chip cookie. My favorite was definitely the Medovik — soft layers with a rich honey flavor that wasn’t too sweet.

A special thanks to Le Thu Hang, who was very friendly and helpful. She carefully introduced the different cakes and suggested drinks that would pair well with them.

Unfortunately I didn’t have time to sit and enjoy a drink, so I took the cakes to go. The view of the lake from the bakery is beautiful though, and it made me wish I could stay longer. I’ll definitely come back next time.

Love this place
Dec 2025 • Couples
The first time we stopped in, it was late, and not much was left. We purchased a vanilla macaron...which was fantastic. The second time was much different. My wife had a vanilla rose latte and an Earl Grey macaron. I ordered a signature herbal cooler tea, lemon cheesecake, red velvet cookie, and a lemon blueberry eclair. The red velvet cookie was ok. Everything else was amazing! That includes the service. Long Pham was extremely kind, patient, and helpful. Yen Nguyen was very friendly, and there was a third person (a young lady) who was also very friendly (unfortunately, we didn't get her name). We will be returning.
